# #189 - Robotduell i lagret

**Feed**: affarsvarlden-analys  
**Published**: 2026-08-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Episode #189 of Affärsvärlden Analys focuses on warehouse/logistics automation, contrasting Swedish micro-cap FlexQube (buy rating, driven by a likely-Amazon order that could quadruple revenue) with Norwegian AutoStore (neutral, cyclical rebound plus its own Amazon deal). The hosts also cover distressed Polish paper maker Arctic Paper (neutral, high-risk binary case), struggling EV-charging/electrification firm Garo (unattractive, bleeding money in e-mobility), and reflect on M&A consolidation in Nordic asset management via Mandatum's acquisition of Klients.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 FLEXQ — FlexQube | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Likely Amazon customer driving ~4x revenue to ~SEK400m; modular self-charging AMR with fast ROI; EV/Sales ~1.5x seen as modest if Amazon scales.

#### Reasoning

Hosts issue a buy on a high-risk micro-cap. 2026 revenue is order-backed; 2027 assumes Amazon phase two (~SEK200m more), 2028 needs further Amazon success. At ~1.5x sales and 2x sales on 2028 estimates the analyst sees ~50% upside. Strong single-customer dependence and tech-cycle risk make it a hope-stock bet, but the risk/reward was deemed attractive enough for a buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Amazon relationship fails to progress to phase two
- if Amazon orders prove one-off and revenue reverts to historical levels
- if humanoid/competing robot tech displaces their AMR
- if ramp-up costs prevent reaching positive operating margin

> *"Men vi tyckte det var tillräckligt spännande för att sätta ett köpråd på det här."*

---

### 🟡 AUTO — AutoStore | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong rebound from tariff-war lows (~5 to ~17 NOK), >30% growth and ~40% margins, plus a new Amazon supply deal; but cyclical with little recurring revenue.

#### Reasoning

Hosts stayed neutral. The stock has tripled and is priced as a long-term automation winner (~20x+ EBIT), yet the business is highly cyclical with hardware/project one-off revenue and can swing fast if uncertainty returns. They flag Q3 seasonal softness and elevated costs as near-term risk, while the Amazon deal offers upside optionality but no concrete purchase commitments yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 comes in seasonally weak with slowing orders
- if macro/tariff uncertainty re-emerges and investment projects pause
- if the Amazon agreement yields no concrete orders

> *"Vi förblev neutrala till den här aktien, men vi tror också att det finns en liten risk här inför tredje kvartalet."*

---

### 🟡 ARP — Arctic Paper | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Distressed graphic fine-paper maker heading to a loss on weak demand and high pulp/energy costs; binary case with ~400% upside if cycle turns vs ~70% downside on a rescue rights issue.

#### Reasoning

Analyst modeled ~400% upside on a cyclical recovery (60% probability) vs ~70% downside (40%) on dilution, making odds look decent, but chose a neutral rather than buy rating because turnaround bets like his past Billerud call tend to fail before visible signs of improvement. Opaque, invisible controlling owner (Tomas Onstad) and loss-making 55% stake in Rottneros add risk; positive owner buying and Rottneros Q2 are early hints.

#### Sell Triggers

- if input costs (Sydamerican short-fiber pulp, energy) stay high
- if demand fails to recover and losses continue
- if a large dilutive rescue rights issue is announced
- if Rottneros keeps losing money

> *"Ja, så vi är nära ett köpråd, men det är ett förhoppningsbolag med hög risk och vi stannade till slut vid en neutral deklaration."*

---

### ⛔ GARO — Garo | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

E-mobility charging business has lost >SEK320m since Q4 2022 with ~-50% op margin and no cost coverage; slow to act on strategic review; stock unattractive now but worth watching.

#### Reasoning

Hosts say the stock looks uninteresting here and now: the EV-charger unit is deeply loss-making in brutal price competition (Zaptec winning), while the electrification base business only muddles along in a weak construction market. Management has been slow ('oil tanker turning') to cut or divest chargers. They'd revisit only once a decisive structural action on the charging unit occurs; new CEO Tobias Byfelt gets a few quarters.

#### Sell Triggers

- thesis flips to buy if management decisively divests/closes the loss-making charging unit
- if the strategic review yields a concrete restructuring
- if e-mobility margins stop deteriorating

> *"Men vi kan inte säga så mycket annat än att här och nu när man bara tittar på Garo idag så känns aktien inte alls intressant faktiskt."*

---

### 🟠 RROS — Rottneros | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Loss-making pulp maker (55% owned by Arctic Paper), but Q2 report looked brighter and stock rose ~50% after the controlling owner bought SEK32m of shares.

#### Reasoning

Not formally rated, but flagged as showing early signs of improvement: a better Q2 and notable insider buying by the otherwise invisible controlling owner drove a sharp rally. Tied to the same pulp-cycle and ownership dynamics as Arctic Paper; a watch item where a genuine cyclical turn is the key catalyst.

#### Sell Triggers

- if pulp prices/demand weaken again
- if losses persist despite Q2 improvement

> *"Men sen, när den osynliga huvudägaren köpte aktier för 32 miljoner, då gick aktien upp nästan 50 procent."*

---
